title: Power Pages: transfer site ownership from the Power Platform admin center
summary: The documented transfer route, role requirements and audit search command are supported, and the rollout facts match the roadmap. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft ownership terminology and remove checklist instructions for auditing setup and role assignment that the controls table does not cover.

claims.claim: No API, command or bulk automation is documented for the ownership-transfer procedure itself in November 2026.

claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages site ownership transfer notification email eligible sites tenant disable switch. Opened transfer-ownership and admin-roles; results describe the transfer, unrelated SharePoint notifications and phishing alerts, not Power Pages transfer emails.

claims.claim: The security recommendations page documents a valid-owner recommendation for apps.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's site security recommendations cover WAF, SSL certificates and authentication keys, not a Power Advisor recommendation for ownerless sites.

Search also returned site inventory and action-center guidance, not the claimed ownerless-site recommendation.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The add-on licensing model refers to Power Pages authenticated user monthly capacity and anonymous user monthly capacity add-ons for external users.
claims.quote: Power Pages is licensed by using authenticated user monthly capacity and anonymous user monthly capacity add-ons for external users.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The transfer page lists roles, admin-center access and a recipient user type as prerequisites without naming a licence.
claims.quote: Searched: licence/license in the fully opened transfer-ownership page. Its prerequisites are website app ownership and admin roles, Power Platform admin center access, and an enabled Microsoft Entra Member recipient; no licence is named.

claims.claim: No meter specific to ownership transfer is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages ownership transfer pricing licensing charge meter. Opened transfer-ownership and website-consumption-reports; read licensing FAQ and pay-as-you-go meters search excerpts. Published meters concern website users and storage, not transfers.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No price or charge specific to ownership transfer is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages ownership transfer pricing licensing charge meter. Opened transfer-ownership and website-consumption-reports; read licensing FAQ and pay-as-you-go meters search excerpts. No transfer-specific price was returned.

claims.claim: No licence condition specific to ownership transfer is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages ownership transfer pricing licensing charge meter. Opened transfer-ownership and website-consumption-reports; read Power Pages licensing and licensing FAQ excerpts. General product licensing is documented, but no transfer-specific licence condition was found.

claims.claim: The roadmap and Learn do not define which sites are eligible or ineligible for transfer.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "transfer" "eligible". Read roadmap description and transfer-ownership, including prerequisites and managed-identity exception. Neither gives site eligibility criteria beyond the published procedure's prerequisites.

claims.claim: No tenant-wide on or off setting for ownership transfer is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "ownership transfer" "disable"; Power Pages site ownership transfer notification email eligible sites tenant disable switch. Opened transfer-ownership, admin-roles and admin-api; no tenant ownership-transfer switch was documented.

claims.claim: Power Pages activity logs are accessible to developers through the Office 365 Management API.
claims.quote: The logs are also accessible to developers via the Office 365 Management API.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The documented procedure is a manual action on a selected site, rather than an automatic transfer when the capability becomes available.
claims.quote: Select the Power Pages site that you want to update. ... In the Owner field, remove the current owner and search for the new owner. ... Review the confirmation message, and then select Transfer.

claims.claim: Learn advises verifying that the new owner can access and manage the site.
claims.quote: Verify that the new owner can access and manage the site.

claims.claim: The roadmap and transfer documentation do not mention an effect on site visitors.
claims.quote: Searched: visitors and access in the supplied roadmap description and fully opened transfer-ownership page. The documented access warning concerns the previous owner; neither text describes a visitor-facing change.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, auditing and role-assignment bullet
claims.claim: The audit row covers the environment auditing setup and audit-role assignment that the checklist tells readers to configure.
claims.quote: Turn on auditing for the production environments ... assign the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs role ... (Purview audit row). The row gives Solutions > Audit and Search-UnifiedAuditLog, which search records rather than configure those prerequisites.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Turn on auditing for the production environments'. Neither environment auditing setup nor audit-role assignment has a configuration row. Retain the verified prerequisites in the row note and Scope; do not add rows.

claims.claim: The table represents the documented absence of a tenant-wide ownership-transfer switch.
claims.quote: The transfer is a per-site admin action with no documented tenant-wide on or off setting in this table. The table contains only a transfer row and an audit-search row, not a tenant-switch absence row.
claims.fix: Replace 'The transfer is a per-site admin action with no documented tenant-wide on or off setting in this table.' with 'The transfer is a per-site admin action.' This removes an absence that has no corresponding row without adding a control.
